data.name: Navghan
data.gender_notes: Navghan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Navghan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'nav', meaning new or fresh. The suffix 'ghan' is derived from the word 'ghana', meaning dense, strong or powerful. Together, Navghan can be interpreted as a new, young, and powerful individual. The name Navghan carries the meaning “New, Fresh, Young” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Navghan usually hope their child will grow to embody new, fresh, young and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Navghan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
